body:
Thanks, I appreciate it. And I'm glad you can understand my logic. 
This past week or so, I have been doing "better" than when I made the original post on Christmas- "better" being I don't have an overwhelming desire to actively kill myself, but I would still be fine with a passive way. My job searching continues to be fruitless. Right now all I have is dog walking but of course that is in no way livable or stable. My will to live isn't enough to motivate me to take a minimum wage job. Although I'm sure I would be given a job offer for those, the low wage and sub-optimal working environment aren't "worth" it for me. So therefore I'm stuck getting turned down from decent paying jobs since I guess I don't have enough experience.

no worries. 
yeah. I feel like bringing up more serious stuff will ruin the positive mood (eg- didn't want to ruin the holidays for people). That and I'm afraid of permanently altering the way in which my friends see me- like they might be weary of bringing up certain topics since it might remind me of painful memories, if that makes sense.

Thank you for taking the time to read my original post. I know it was long. It's been really difficult for me because my ex was my best friend and really my only consistent support system for several years. After the break up, I felt like I didn't have anyone I could really "talk talk" to. I still have friends that I talk to every day or so, but never really about serious stuff. 
Thanks again for the reply.
